label: Rotating y
source: Aidan Burns, The Highgate Collection: 2017 expanded PDF printed p. 293 / PDF p. 294; 2014 PDF printed p. 211 / PDF p. 212.
notation: Four-count pass cycle: Anne→Daniel, Daniel→Ben, Ben→Clare, Clare→Anne; each juggler self-throws between passes.
notes: The prose identifies each pass recipient and says everyone passes four count. The diagram shows four events per juggler per cycle (R,L,R,L): the first throw is the pass, followed by the self-throw chain. Each event lands at the recipient’s next event; the repeated final self edge wraps to the next cycle. The six-step formation pictures are movement illustrations and do not change this causal cycle.
variants: Rotating λ is a separate Australian variation and is not included here.
modelLimits: This graph encodes the four-count causal cycle, not the jugglers’ spatial paths around the y formation.
